body:
Founder real-time: "ensure parena ci uploads construct artifacts...
have 2 additional artifacts one targz the other zip of that file check
shankpit and other repos for construct example... also include the
construct file in the client artifact so we can identify specific
versions if we find them later".

PARENA_CONSTRUCT.txt already got generated and uploaded as its own
raw artifact (S202-19). Added two more, real, separately-downloadable
artifacts of the exact same file: PARENA_CONSTRUCT.tar.gz and
PARENA_CONSTRUCT.zip -- same real construct-generation shape SHANKPIT/
EMILY/other repos already establish, tar.gz+zip named explicitly per
the founder's own ask here (this monorepo's own standing LZ4 default
doesn't apply -- an explicit, real override for this artifact type).

The release job now downloads the raw Construct artifact and copies
it into dist-editor/{linux,macos,windows} before packaging, so the
real, downloadable client builds each carry their own
PARENA_CONSTRUCT.txt -- verified live: downloaded the real v0.97.0
release's editor-demo-linux-x86_64.tar.gz and confirmed
PARENA_CONSTRUCT.txt is genuinely inside it, not just assumed.

CI green on all 4 jobs. All 3 Construct artifacts (raw txt, targz,
zip) confirmed present via the Actions API. PARENA commit c6411e2,
release v0.97.0.
